summary: Mobile County, Alabama, Aermotor MC-39 tower built by CCC Camp S-52; both register pages say removed in the late 2010s. Build year conflicts (1933 vs 1939).

facts.design: 100-foot Aermotor MC-39 steel tower with 7 by 7 foot cab
facts.status_note: Both register pages say the tower was removed in the late 2010s; neither gives an exact year or a reason

events.note: Description on both pages says constructed in 1933 by CCC Camp S-52; the Built field on both pages says 1939
Registered December 23, 2009 on the National Historic Lookout Register; nominated by Thomas Kaufmann
Registered January 8, 2021 on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register

corrections.proposed: late 2010s (no exact year; no removed event recorded)
corrections.why: The Removed field reads 'late 2010s'. The brief read it as 2010 and added '(about 2010)', which the pages do not support.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The description text says 1933 (CCC Camp S-52); the Built field says 1939 on both pages. The sources conflict, so the story reports both and the built event uses the description's 1933.

notes_for_editor: Both register pages carry the same description, so the history rests on one register text plus its dates. Build year conflicts: 1933 in the description vs 1939 in the Built field. Removal is only 'late 2010s', so no removed event was recorded. Elevation differs between the pages (263 ft / 80 m on NHLR vs 293 ft / 89 m on FFLOS); the brief's 80.2 m matches NHLR and was left alone. Corrections: status standing -> removed; the brief's 2010 removal year misread the field. No photos added. Not verified: any post-removal state of the site, and the reason for removal. A 1819 News column by Thomas Kaufmann and the Encyclopedia of Alabama CCC article were read for context but not cited.
